jobDescription.name: What you’ll be up to
jobDescription.value:
You have a passion for numbers? Taking processes to the next level is something you enjoy? An awesome team is waiting for you!

We are tado°, a growing scale-up that develops smart energy and climate solutions to make life at home more sustainable and comfortable.

To continue our growth, we are looking for a dedicated Team Lead Accounting (m/f/d) who combines hands-on accounting expertise with strong ownership and enjoys actively shaping the future of accounting processes.

Your Impact:

  • You’ll lead the Accounting department with 3 team members from Junior to Senior and directly report to the Head of Finance.

  • Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including general ledger, accounts payable/ receivable and fixed assets, and ensure timely and accurate monthly/ annual financial closings.

jobDescription.name: What makes you a great fit:
jobDescription.value:
• A completed commercial education or a business-related Bachelor’s degree, with 6+ years of relevant experience

  • Strong knowledge of accounting standards (e. g. HGB, UGB) and VAT regulations

jobDescription.name: Our Benefits
jobDescription.value:
• Flexible working hours to accommodate your schedule and remote-friendly work environment within Germany, with the option for temporary work from abroad within the EU.

  • 30 annual paid vacation days and a contribution to your company pension scheme.

tado° is an equal opportunity employer and we are striving for a diverse workforce. Thus, we recruit talented individuals based solely on their competencies and skills, without any regard to their race, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, age, religion, belief, or disability.
